entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Eslamiyeh, also known as the Farashah Shrine, is a Shi'ite Friday mosque (jāmeh) and shrine located on the historical axis of Eslamiyeh, in Taft County, in the province of Yazd, Iran.
